name: zenuml
description: Draw ZenUML sequence diagrams, Mermaid, PlantUML, draw.io and OpenAPI diagrams in ChatGPT from text. No account or sign-in; nothing is saved.

interface.longDescription:
Draw diagrams in ChatGPT from text: ZenUML sequence diagrams, Mermaid flowcharts and other Mermaid diagrams, PlantUML, diagrams.net (draw.io) XML, and OpenAPI or Swagger specifications.

Ask for a sequence diagram of a code path, a flowchart of a process, or a picture of an API, and ChatGPT writes the source and ZenUML draws it right in the conversation. If the source does not parse, ZenUML reports each error with its line and column so ChatGPT can fix it and draw again.

No account or sign-in is needed, and nothing is saved: the diagram lives only in your conversation.
capabilities: Draw ZenUML sequence diagrams from text
Draw Mermaid flowcharts, state, class and other Mermaid diagrams
Draw PlantUML, draw.io XML and OpenAPI specifications
Report parse errors with line and column so the diagram can be fixed
defaultPrompt: Draw a sequence diagram of an OAuth login with PKCE
Turn these deploy steps into a flowchart
Draw this OpenAPI spec as API documentation

positive.description: Draws a ZenUML sequence diagram from a description.
positive.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram where a user logs in through a web app that calls an auth service and a user database.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a rendered sequence diagram with User, WebApp, AuthService and the database, and says the source parsed.

positive.prompt: Draw a flowchart of these steps: build, test, deploy to staging, deploy to production.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a rendered left-to-right or top-down flowchart with the four steps in order.

positive.description: Draws PlantUML when asked for it.
positive.prompt: Draw a PlantUML class diagram with Order, OrderLine and Product, where an Order has many OrderLines.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a rendered PlantUML class diagram with the three classes and the one-to-many association.

positive.prompt: Draw an OpenAPI spec for a small pet store API with GET /pets and POST /pets.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the rendered API documentation with both operations.

positive.description: Handles a source that does not parse.
positive.prompt: Draw this ZenUML diagram: A->B.call() { B->C: notify {
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT either corrects the unclosed braces before drawing, or the first render_diagram call reports the parse errors with line and column and ChatGPT corrects them and calls again. Either way the final result says the source parsed, the diagram is shown, and ChatGPT says what it changed.

negative.description: Unrelated request; the app should not be used.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Explanation request with no drawing; ChatGPT can answer without the tool.
negative.prompt: Explain what a UML sequence diagram is.

negative.description: Request to save to a third-party service, which this app cannot do; it should not claim to have saved anything.
negative.prompt: Save this diagram to my Confluence page.
